media.title: Ernst Marischka — portrait in Kinematographische Rundschau (1913)
media.description: Portrait of Austrian screenwriter, director and lyricist Ernst Marischka, published in Kinematographische Rundschau in 1913 and reproduced in the Theatermuseum press material for Showbiz Made in Vienna: The Marischkas.
media.altText: Portrait of Ernst Marischka published in Kinematographische Rundschau in 1913.
media.rightsNote: External link only; no copy of the portrait is hosted by this site. The Theatermuseum press material credits the reproduction to the Österreichisches Filmmuseum and permits the supplied press photographs free of charge only in connection with press coverage of the exhibition.
